title: Unable to reset password
description: Customer does not receive the password reset email after three attempts.

title: Payment failed at checkout
description: Customer receives a payment declined message even though the card is valid.

title: Account access locked
description: Customer is locked out after too many sign-in attempts and cannot access the account.

title: Service outage in billing portal
description: Customer cannot load the billing portal and receives a service unavailable message.

title: Password reset link expired
description: Customer reports that the password reset link expires immediately after it is opened.

title: Duplicate payment charge
description: Customer was charged twice for the same subscription renewal.

title: Unable to update account email
description: Customer receives an error when saving a new account email address.

title: Mobile account access issue
description: Customer can sign in on the website but receives an error in the mobile application.

title: Service outage notification delay
description: Customer did not receive an outage notification during a regional interruption.

title: Critical account access failure
description: Customer cannot access the account and the recovery process also fails.
